messages:
maya: Quick ops bulletin — checkpoint for this week's release train. Heads-up: release freeze window starts in ~2 hours (175m) for the major rollout. Please stop pushing non-critical changes after the freeze. :warning:

maya: Highlights: 1) Canary of new quantization kernels (q4f) shows ~3% p50 latency improvement on gen-heavy workloads. 2) Embeddings service bumped to model v2.3 (vector size same) — perf/accuracy looked good in evals. 3) Routing policy update: requests >2s now route to fallback model variant for tier-A customers.

maya: Canary scope: 10% traffic across regions eu-west/ashburn for the next 3h. Rollout plan if canary OK: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 24h with automated health gates.

deepak: acked. I'll monitor GPU queue depths during canary and keep you posted. :thumbsup:

sara: Quick Q — any DB migration or schema changes included? Need to coordinate infra window if so.

maya: No schema changes in this train. One runtime config change for cache TTLs (shorter) to reduce mem pressure during rollout. No migration required.

eli: Deploy-bot status: `canary-started` 1778009930, canary-id=cny-84, targets: eu-west1, ashburn1. Initial health: 99.6% success, avg p50 +2.8% vs baseline (expected w/ quantization warmup).

simon: We have a late security hotpatch (CVE-2026-1145) that needs to land. It's low-risk but touches the routing layer. Can we get a freeze exception to include it in this cycle?

maya: @simon — yes, approve exception for the security hotpatch only. Please follow the hotpatch checklist and request explicit oncall approval before merge. Add an entry in the release notes under "security hotpatches".

simon: Will do. Hotpatch PR will be small, referencing this thread. I'll tag oncall when ready.

deploy-bot: canary-health-check: checks= [error-rate,latency,trace-errors], thresholds=(err<1.5%, p50<=baseline*1.12, errors downtrend). Current: err=0.9%, p50=1.028x, traces stable.

deepak: observed a tiny spike in batching queue at t+15m, but cleared after autoscaler adjustment. No customer-facing impact.

maya: Oncall note: @eli or @deepak please be available for the first 4h of the canary window. If any gate fails, follow rollback runbook: `scripts/rollback_release.sh --canary cny-84 --force` and notify #incidents.

sara: Copy that — I'll update the release notes draft with the TTL change and quantization callouts.

eli: Will also cross-post a short summary to #customer-success if rollout hits 30% so CS teams aren't surprised.

maya: Exec FYI: CEO asked for a one-line update after the 30% step. I'll draft that. If anything unexpected, escalate to leadership immediately.

simon: tagging PR: https://git.internal/r/4521 (hotpatch) — ETA for merge in ~45m pending oncall sign-off.

maya: Thanks all. Quick checklist before freeze: 1) stop non-critical merges, 2) confirm canary health at t+2h, 3) ensure rollback command tested, 4) security hotpatch merge only with oncall approval.

deepak: noted and standing by.

eli: thanks, closing loop.
